# Nacian x402 API

This origin exposes two paid x402 endpoints:
- `POST https://api.nacian.app/query` — one-shot DeFi data query, streamed NDJSON response.
- `POST https://api.nacian.app/alert` — create a time-bounded monitoring alert with webhook notification.
- Protocol version: x402 v2

Supported protocol coverage by chain:
- Ethereum: Uniswap V2, Uniswap V3, Uniswap V4, Sushiswap V2/V3, Pancakeswap V2/V3, Aave V2, Aave V3, Compound V3, ENS, Lido
- Base: Uniswap V3, Sushiswap V2/V3, Pancakeswap V2/V3, Aerodrome V3, Aave V3
- Arbitrum: Uniswap V3, Sushiswap V2/V3, Camelot V3, Aave V3, Compound V3
- Polygon: 

Validation schema:
- `https://api.nacian.app/.well-known/x402-schemas/validate`
- Returned in endpoint headers as `X-Validation-Schema` for x402scan.

POST /query request body:
- `messages` (required): chat history in OpenAI-style message format.
- `model` (optional): `deepseek3.2` | `minimax-2.5` | `gemini-3-flash`.
- `maxOutputTokens` (optional): integer between 1500 and 5000.

POST /alert request body:
- `messages` (required): chat history describing the alert condition.
- `webhookUrl` (required): HTTPS URL to POST when the alert condition is triggered.
- `model` (optional): `deepseek3.2` | `minimax-2.5` | `gemini-3-flash`.
- `maxOutputTokens` (optional): integer between 1500 and 5000.
- `maxMinutes` (optional): alert lifetime in minutes (5–10080, default 5).
- `frequencySeconds` (optional): check interval in seconds (30–86400, default 300).

Response format (both endpoints):
- NDJSON stream. /query: `{"type":"content","text":"..."}`. /alert additionally emits `{"type":"alert-created","alert":{...}}`.
